title: Original observations along Three and Twenty Creek

network_binding.endpoint_matching: Exact equality of original WGS84 endpoint coordinates; no endpoint snapping

methods.orientation: Downstream minus upstream; original B−A interval and geographic sign retained in each row. Negation swaps bounds and endpoint inclusivity.
methods.project_scope: Exact upstream/downstream project pair retained in each statistical cohort.
methods.time_support: Same original calendar day; original clocks and timezone labels retained verbatim. Clock offsets are not travel times.
methods.seasons: DJF, MAM, JJA and SON by original sampling month; December belongs to following DJF season-year. Uneven observed sample coverage is retained.
methods.intervals: Nonnegative below-limit intervals and unbounded above-limit intervals come from original study kernels; no censor substitution. Null means unbounded endpoint, not zero.
methods.weighting: One compatible activity comparison per measure; agreeing repeated 2026 result rows count once per activity and characteristic, while each distinct original ResultIdentifier remains available. Reconstructed TN remains a named derived measure.
methods.exclusions: Exact source-owned flagged pH result STORET-1104042240 remains in excluded_original_records and original files; it enters no contrast or summary.
methods.scope: Observed concentration and field-measurement differences; no flux/load, compliance, transport-time or causal inference.
